name: krypton
description: Krypton — Autonomous Desktop AI Agent Runtime

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @krypton/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @krypton/agent-runtime build && pnpm --filter @krypton/cli build
scripts.build:binaries:win: node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target win && node scripts/build-cli.mjs --target win
scripts.build:binaries:mac: node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target mac-arm && node scripts/build-cli.mjs --target mac-arm
scripts.build:binaries:mac-intel: node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target mac-intel && node scripts/build-cli.mjs --target mac-intel
scripts.build:binaries:linux: node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target linux && node scripts/build-cli.mjs --target linux
scripts.build:binaries:linux-arm: node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target linux-arm64 && node scripts/build-cli.mjs --target linux-arm64
scripts.build:binaries:all: pnpm build:binaries:win && pnpm build:binaries:mac && pnpm build:binaries:linux
scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm build:binaries && pnpm build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @krypton/shared-types typecheck && pnpm --filter @krypton/agent-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @krypton/cli typecheck
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter @krypton/shared-types test && pnpm --filter @krypton/agent-runtime test && pnpm --filter @krypton/cli test && pnpm --filter desktop test && cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
